goal: Prevent projects from staying active because useful new ideas are absorbed into the original scope instead of becoming follow-on projects.

trigger_rule.required_action: Create a follow-on project and preserve the original project's acceptance criteria.
trigger_rule.forbidden_behavior: Do not keep adding related improvements to the current project while the original acceptance remains incomplete.

completion_pressure_rule.question: Has the original acceptance criteria been completed?

mim_behavior: When Codex, TOD, or MIM proposes adjacent work, compare it to the project's original acceptance criteria.
If the adjacent work expands scope by more than 30%, create a follow-on project.
Keep the original project focused on closure.
Report scope expansion in the Project board and MIM Command Brief.
Ask whether acceptance is complete before recommending enhancements.
tod_behavior: Implement the current driving task only.
Report evidence against the original acceptance criteria.
Do not mark progress based only on unrelated architecture or dashboard work.
Escalate if reconciliation downgrades completed work or masks incomplete acceptance.

first_failure_case.original_scope: sortable headers, quick filters, searchable table, preserve row opening
first_failure_case.repair: Complete the original table controls, mark the project completed, and treat momentum/scope discipline as follow-on projects.

acceptance_criteria: Projects page shows acceptance criteria for each project.
Projects page shows Scope Stable, Scope Watch, or Scope Expanded.
Projects page counts projects missing acceptance criteria.
MIM Command Brief recommends splitting expanded scope before continuing broad improvements.
MIM Command Brief recommends defining acceptance before tracking progress when acceptance is missing.
Completed projects cannot be downgraded to working by reconciliation.
